limits: Only the specified cases and these fresh reader-agent sessions were evaluated. Two calibration readers each saw five cases; one additional reader saw five baseline cases, so cases are not independent human subjects.
These findings do not establish human usability, natural voice, spoken/audio usability or reliability for other models. Read-aloud answers were text judgments; no human listening test occurred.
No product runtime, platform connection, audio, OAuth or live command tests were executed. Named build/final acceptance checks remain root-owned and are not run by this evaluation.
No writer pages, seed keys or reader answers/verdicts were edited. Fact PASS records establish individual source/answer support, not an overall calibration or pilot acceptance.
